seekers.audience: Seeker’s Bible You may have come to this book from another faith, or from none. You are welcome to read it as it is. Everyone needs the Father. Father’s Heart Bible is a fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — not adapted from any existing English Bible. For the first time in print, you can see which words are His. Our Father’s words in BLUE. The Son’s in RED. The Spirit’s in PURPLE. Your Father speaks 125,457 words here, for you to believe and receive. When Paul stood in Athens he did not attack what the people there already believed. He told them he could see how religious they were, pointed at their own altar to a god they had not named, and quoted their own poets back to them. Then he told them who they had been reaching for all along. “What you worship without knowing it, I now proclaim to you.” — Acts 17:23 “so they might seek our Father, perhaps reach for him and find him — though he is not far from each of us.” — Acts 17:27 He is not far from you either. Read it for yourself, and see who is speaking. Come, hear your Father’s voice.
